articles.title: Eleven injured in shooting outside Turkish school
articles.description: Footage appears to show a male in the area carrying a firearm, while officials say the attacker has been captured.

articles.title: Outrage in India over viral video of teen molested and her friend beaten
articles.description: Three minors were arrested after videos capturing the assault went viral in India, sparking anger.

articles.title: Doctor in court to face Rwanda genocide charges in UK

articles.description: The storm pulled away from Japan after bringing heavy rains and strong winds to Tokyo and surrounding areas.

articles.description: The man had jumped in to save a father and son in difficulty in the water, local officials say.

articles.title: Young Berliners vote overwhelmingly for socialist Left  Party
articles.description: Berlin's young voters overwhelmingly supported the victorious socialist Left Party. Are the young more radical? Or is that just a reflection of current German politics?
articles.titleJa: ベルリンの若者、社会主義左翼党に圧倒的支持
articles.summary: ベルリンの若年層有権者が勝利した社会主義左翼党を圧倒的に支持。若者がより過激になっているのか、それとも現在のドイツ政治の反映なのかを検証する。

articles.title: Living in the shadow of LA's hidden oil wells
articles.description: Many lifelong residents of Los Angeles have health impacts from growing up so close to oil extraction. Now, the city is trying to close down the worst offenders, but it's an enormous task.
articles.titleJa: ロサンゼルスの隠れた油井の影で暮らす人々
articles.summary: ロサンゼルスの長年の住民は、油田近くで育ったことで健康に影響を受けている。市は最悪の油井を閉鎖しようとしているが、その作業は多大なものだ。

articles.title: After floods, Nepal minister demands 'climate justice'
articles.description: With Nepal still reeling from the devastating floods in August, Kathmandu is calling for climate justice and seeking compensation from the UN-backed Loss and Damage Fund, Environment Minister Geeta Chaudhary told DW.
articles.titleJa: 洪水後、ネパール大臣が「気候正義」を要求
articles.summary: 8月の壊滅的な洪水から立ち直れないネパールは、「気候正義」を求め、国連が支援する損失と損害基金からの補償を要求している。

articles.title: Could we see MMA at the Olympics?
articles.description: Mixed martial arts has made its debut at the Asian Games this week. It takes the sport closer to the Olympics but there are doubts about the next step, and the influence of the popular and lucrative UFC.

articles.summary: 総合格闘技（MMA）が今週のアジア競技大会でデビュー。オリンピックに近づく一方で、次のステップや人気と収益性の高いUFCの影響について疑問が残る。

articles.title: Iran war spreads through region as Trump seeks way out

articles.title: Turkey: Several pupils injured in shooting outside school
articles.description: The shooter, a pupil, allegedly took a rifle and shot indiscriminately at his schoolmates in front of their high school. Turkey was shocked by two back-to-back school shootings earlier this year.
articles.titleJa: トルコ：学校外での銃撃事件で生徒数名が負傷
articles.summary: トルコで、生徒がライフルを持ち高校前で無差別に発砲し、数名が負傷。今年相次いだ学校銃撃事件に社会は衝撃を受けている。

articles.title: Russia, Ukraine trade deadly strikes as Zelenskyy attends UNGA
articles.description: The Russian army targeted economic infrastructure in Ukraine, while Ukraine struck an oil refinery. This comes ahead of the UN General Assembly, where President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is due to meet Trump on the sidelines.

articles.summary: ロシア軍はウクライナの経済インフラを標的とし、ウクライナは石油精製施設を攻撃。ゼレンスキー大統領が国連総会に出席し、トランプ前大統領と会談する直前の出来事だ。

articles.title: Male infertility is 'grossly underreported'
articles.description: It's not all on women anymore — doctors do test men for sperm count and motility. But still too few men get checked, possibly due to a misconception that a healthy sex life means healthy sperm. Spoiler: It doesn't.
articles.titleJa: 男性不妊は「著しく過少報告されている」
articles.summary: 男性不妊は「著しく過少報告」されており、健康な性生活が健康な精子を意味しないという誤解から、検査を受ける男性が少ないと指摘されている。

articles.title: UNGA: Leaders gather as General Assembly kicks off
articles.description: World leaders have begun gathering in New York for the UN General Assembly. US President Trump will address the body on Tuesday, as will his Finnish, French and Turkish counterparts. Follow DW for the latest.
articles.titleJa: 国連総会：開会とともに各国首脳が集結
articles.summary: 国連総会がニューヨークで開幕し、世界各国の首脳が集結。トランプ米大統領のほか、フィンランド、フランス、トルコの大統領らが演説を行う予定だ。

articles.title: Healthcare in Africa ‘under growing strain’ after US withdrawal from aid programs, report warns
articles.description:
Accra Reset’s report states countries in the region and global south should take greater control of their health development after USAID debacle
The United States’ withdrawal from key aid programs has put has put healthcare in Africa and the Global South “under growing strain” a new report warns.
The report says the Trump administration’s cuts to programs such as US Agency for International Development (USAID), as well as the Covid-19 pandemic and rising costs of living globally have brought “new urgency” for the need to reform healthcare in the region.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国の援助プログラム撤退後、アフリカの医療に「増大する負担」と報告書が警告
articles.summary: 米国の援助プログラムからの撤退により、アフリカとグローバルサウスの医療システムに負担が増加していると報告書が警告。トランプ政権の政策転換が影響。

articles.title: Banished to alien lands: Trump’s secret deportation deals
articles.description:
After a plane journey in shackles, an Iranian woman found herself in the middle of Africa in a country she did not know existed. She is one of thousands deported from the US on the back of shadowy deals made with dozens of countries. An in-depth investigation reveals the ‘show of force’ costing American taxpayers millions
No one would tell the shackled detainees onboard the US immigration plane where they were going. The officers in charge would taunt them when they asked, they said. It was only when the seat-back video screens finally showed a map that the 18 migrants worked it out.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 異国へ追放：トランプ政権の秘密裏の強制送還協定
articles.summary: トランプ政権が数千人を強制送還するため、数十カ国と秘密裏に協定を結んでいたことが判明。米国からの強制送還者の厳しい実態が明らかに。

articles.title: Men deported from US bound and beaten in Equatorial Guinea detention hotel, lawyers say
articles.description:
Group trapped at Hotel Bamy after US removal as rights groups sound alarm over poor conditions and violence

Two men that the Trump administration expelled to Equatorial Guinea were bound, fitted with bags over their heads, beaten and pushed down a flight of stairs, all in plain view of other US deportees, according to witnesses and human rights lawyers.
The men – one from Egypt and one from Eritrea – were then taken to a prison. About 30 detainees from the US remain trapped at a hotel in the outskirts of the coastal city of Malabo after being deported from the US. Detainees have said they believe the men were beaten for telling the press and human rights advocates about the poor conditions and violence inside the hotel, and that they are haunted by flashbacks and terrified they will be retaliated against next.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国から強制送還された男性らが赤道ギニアの収容ホテルで拘束され暴行を受けたと弁護士が証言
articles.summary: トランプ政権により赤道ギニアに強制送還された男性らが、ホテルで拘束され暴行を受けたとの証言。人権団体が懸念を表明。

articles.title: Survivors recount panic and struggle to breathe in Nigerian prison cell where 37 died
articles.description:
Police fire teargas as protests break out in city of Minna after deaths of suspected illegal goldminers, many of whom were children
Survivors from a prison cell in Nigeria where 37 suspected illegal goldminers died while in the custody of a paramilitary group this week have recounted their panic and struggle for breath, as police on Friday fired teargas at people protesting against the deaths and imposed an overnight curfew in the city of Minna.
The victims – many of whom were children – were found dead on Thursday in the cells of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC), which had raided suspected illegal goldmines and ⁠locked up dozens of miners in the city, the state capital of the mineral-rich state of Niger.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ナイジェリアの刑務所独房で37人が死亡、生存者がパニックと呼吸困難を語る
articles.summary: ナイジェリアの刑務所独房で違法金採掘容疑者37人が死亡。生存者が当時の苦痛を語り、街では抗議デモが発生し警察が催涙ガスを発射。

articles.title: British woman who was kidnapped in Malawi rescued by police after shootout
articles.description:
Four of Nusrat Osman’s alleged abductors were killed during rescue after she was taken from outside her home last week
A British woman kidnapped in Malawi last week has been rescued by police after a shootout in which four of her alleged abductors were killed.
Nusrat Osman was abducted outside her home in the southern city of Blantyre on 11 September at about 12.30pm. Police had offered a reward of 30m Malawi kwacha (£12,950) for information leading to her rescue and the arrest of the perpetrators.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: マラウイで誘拐された英国人女性、銃撃戦の末に警察が救出
articles.summary: マラウイで誘拐された英国人女性が、警察による銃撃戦の末に救出された。容疑者4人が死亡。

articles.title: British Columbia sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over Tumbler Ridge mass school shooting
articles.description:
Canadian province alleges deadly attack could have been prevented if  company had warned police of shooter’s ChatGPT use
British Columbia has sued OpenAI in California, saying a mass shooting at a school in the province could have been prevented if the company had warned local ⁠law enforcement that the shooter ⁠had used ChatGPT to ​plan the massacre.
The lawsuit filed in San Francisco federal court on Monday names OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman, as defendants. It is seeking damages to fund recovery efforts in the province after the February attack, as well as an order directing changes to the way the company handles ChatGPT conversations that could lead to violence.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ブリティッシュコロンビア州、タンブラーリッジの学校銃乱射事件でOpenAIとサム・アルトマンを提訴
articles.summary: カナダのブリティッシュコロンビア州が、AIが銃乱射計画に使われたとしてOpenAIを提訴。AI企業の法的責任を問う異例の裁判。

articles.title: Colombia declares public calamity as wildfire threatens popular tourist area
articles.description:
Wildfire forces evacuations and burns through mountains surrounding Villa de Leyva in the north-east 
Colombian authorities declared a public calamity as a wildfire burned through mountains surrounding one of the country’s best-known colonial towns in the north-east, scorching large swaths of vegetation and forcing evacuations.
Nearly 20 active fires are burning across the South American country. Dry conditions have increased fire danger in Colombia as it braces for the effects of El Niño, which can help wildfires spread.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: コロンビア、人気観光地を脅かす山火事により公共の災害を宣言
articles.summary: コロンビア当局が山火事により公共の災害を宣言。人気観光地の周辺で大規模な火災が発生し、避難を余儀なくされている。

articles.title: US strikes on alleged drug boats may constitute ‘crimes against humanity’, UN expert says
articles.description:
Dozens of US attacks on boats in the Pacific and Caribbean have killed more than 230 people since September 2025
A special rapporteur for the UN human rights council has concluded that there are “reasonable grounds to believe” that the United States attacks on boats allegedly carrying drugs in the Pacific and Caribbean “constituted crimes against humanity”.
The boat strikes, carried out since September 2025 on the stated grounds of stopping drugs being trafficked by sea to the US, have killed more than 230 people. The latest, on Saturday, killed four people in the Caribbean.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国による麻薬密輸船への攻撃は「人道に対する罪」に該当する可能性、国連専門家が指摘
articles.summary: 国連専門家が、米国が麻薬密輸船に対し行った攻撃が「人道に対する罪」に当たる可能性を指摘。230人以上が死亡したとされる。

articles.title: Man and police officer wounded in exchange of gunfire near Ontario synagogue
articles.description:
Officials say man was critically injured and officer was wounded in Yom Kippur incident near Belleville synagogue
A police officer and a man were wounded in an exchange of gunfire on Sunday near a synagogue in Ontario as members of the Jewish community marked Yom Kippur, authorities said. The man was hospitalized in life-threatening condition.
The Canadian province’s special investigations unit said the exchange of gunfire happened near the Sons of Jacob Synagogue in Belleville, Ontario, about 110 miles (160km) east of Toronto. Belleville police said the officer encountered the man at about 7.10pm and that both were taken to a hospital.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: オンタリオ州のシナゴーグ付近で銃撃戦、男性と警察官が負傷
articles.summary: カナダ、オンタリオ州ベルビル市のシナゴーグ付近で銃撃戦が発生し、男性と警察官が負傷した。ユダヤ教のヨム・キプール中に発生。

articles.title: Macron and Carney announce closer France-Canada ties amid Trump tensions
articles.description:
Two leaders meet in French territory off Canada as Ottawa seeks stronger relations with EU while fighting trade war with US
The leaders of France and Canada have pledged closer ties to grapple with rising geopolitical tensions, climate change and the erosion of democratic values, after ⁠they met in a ⁠French territory off Canada’s Atlantic coast.
The two leaders’ visit to Saint-Pierre ​and Miquelon – the first by a French president since 2014 and the first by a Canadian prime minister – came just weeks ⁠after Donald Trump posted an image showing the islands, as well as all of Canada and other countries in North America, covered by the US flag.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: マクロン仏大統領とカーニー加首相、トランプ政権との緊張の中、仏加間の緊密な関係を発表
articles.summary: フランスとカナダの首脳が、地政学的緊張や気候変動、民主主義の価値の浸食に対処するため、より緊密な関係を約束。トランプ氏との緊張が背景にある。

articles.title: 'I'm done with medical abuse': actor Arnaud Denis dies by euthanasia in Belgium
articles.description: The French actor and director had been in unbearable pain since a polypropylene prosthesis was fitted in 2023 after a right groin hernia. Aged 43, he was euthanised this Tuesday in Namur, Belgium.
articles.titleJa: 「医療虐待はもうたくさん」俳優アルノー・ドゥニ氏、ベルギーで安楽死
articles.summary: フランス人俳優アルノー・ドゥニ氏（43歳）が、2023年の手術後の耐え難い痛みのため、ベルギーのナミュールで安楽死した。

articles.title: Hidden gem to holiday hotspot: How Albania became one of Europe’s fastest-growing travel destinations
articles.description: The number of tourists visiting the Balkan nation has doubled in the past decade as more and more people discover its fascinating history, brilliant beaches and awe-inspiring hiking trails.
articles.titleJa: 隠れた名所から人気の休暇スポットへ：アルバニアがいかにしてヨーロッパで最も急成長する旅行先の一つになったか
articles.summary: アルバニアは、その魅力的な歴史や美しい自然が注目され、過去10年間で観光客数が倍増し、ヨーロッパで最も急成長している旅行先の一つとなっている。

articles.title: Brussels seeks power to order electricity demand cuts in energy crisis

articles.summary: 欧州委員会は、将来のエネルギー危機における停電を防ぐため、電力需要削減を命令するより直接的な管理権限を求めている。

articles.title: Spanish farmers demand urgent aid as war in Iran drives up costs
articles.description: Asaja, COAG, UPA, Unión de Uniones and the agri-food cooperatives are urging the government for direct aid over soaring farm diesel and fertiliser prices caused by the war in Iran, warning protests will go ahead if no action is taken.
articles.titleJa: イラン戦争によるコスト上昇を受け、スペイン農家が緊急援助を要求
articles.summary: イラン戦争に起因する農用ディーゼルと肥料価格の高騰を受け、スペインの農家団体は政府に直接援助を要求しており、行動がなければ抗議活動を行うと警告している。

articles.title: British Prime Minister Burnham declines to rule out rejoining EU
articles.description: The divisive nature of the 2016 Brexit vote has proved tricky to shake off for many in the UK, and the debate has once more been thrust under the spotlight this year.
articles.titleJa: 英国首相バーナム氏、EU再加盟を排除せず
articles.summary: 英国首相バーナム氏がEU再加盟の可能性を排除せず、2016年のブレグジット投票以来続く国内の分断された議論が再び注目を集めている。

articles.title: ECB calls for tougher EU crypto rules and wider ban on stablecoin interest
articles.description: Europe's central banks want the EU's crypto rules tightened, calling for a wider ban on interest payments on stablecoins, new powers to curb tokens pegged to foreign currencies such as the US dollar, and EU-level supervision of crypto firms.

articles.title: Rethinking Waste: The journey towards a circular economy
articles.description: From advanced sorting in Sharjah to new waste infrastructure in Uzbekistan, efforts to recover materials and generate energy are changing what happens to rubbish.
articles.titleJa: ごみを見直す：循環型経済への道のり
articles.summary: シャルジャの高度なごみ分別からウズベキスタンの新しい廃棄物インフラまで、資源回収とエネルギー生成の取り組みが、ごみ処理方法を変革し循環型経済への道を切り開く。

articles.title: How Turkish business groups are turning İstanbul into a global cultural hub
articles.description: From Sabancı's Yoko Ono exhibition to İstanbul Modern's Renzo Piano building, Turkish conglomerates are investing heavily in culture to boost the city's global appeal.
articles.titleJa: トルコのビジネスグループがイスタンブールをいかにグローバル文化ハブに変えているか
articles.summary: トルコの大企業は、オノ・ヨーコ展やレンゾ・ピアノ設計のイスタンブール・モダン美術館など、文化に多額を投資し、イスタンブールを国際的な文化ハブへと変貌させている。

articles.title: US open to meeting Iran at UN as conflicting reports over peace deal swirl
articles.description: Tehran’s decision-making structures appear gripped by a war of words as conflicting reports emerge on Tuesday about an agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days if the US eases its military pressure.
articles.titleJa: 米国、国連でイランとの会談に前向き 和平合意巡る錯綜する報道
articles.summary: 米国が軍事圧力を緩和すればホルムズ海峡を再開するという合意を巡り、イラン内部で錯綜する報道がある中、米国は国連でのイランとの会談に前向きな姿勢を見せている。

articles.title: Zelenskyy asks EU countries to keep Usmanov and Fridman under sanctions
articles.description: The EU must not remove Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman from the sanctions list, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said amid fraught negotiations in Brussels. "Pressure on Moscow must be strengthened," he said.

articles.summary: ゼレンスキー大統領はブリュッセルでの交渉中、EU各国に対し、オリガルヒのウスマノフ氏とフリドマン氏を制裁リストから削除しないよう要請し、モスクワへの圧力を強化すべきだと述べた。

articles.title: Colombia eases gun restrictions despite fears of more violence
articles.description: Colombia has loosened gun laws after more than a decade of restrictions. Some fear it will lead to even more violence.
articles.titleJa: コロンビア、暴力増加の懸念にもかかわらず銃規制を緩和
articles.summary: コロンビアが10年以上の規制を経て銃器法を緩和。一部では、これにより暴力がさらに増加するとの懸念が広がっています。

articles.title: Iran delegation to present narrative of resilience, diplomacy at UNGA

articles.summary: イラン代表団がニューヨークで開催される国連総会に到着。米国との「戦争」に関する見解を表明する予定です。

articles.title: Hundreds flee homes in Far North Cameroon after armed group raid kills 15
articles.description: No group claims responsibility for attack, but suspicion falls on ISIL affiliate.

articles.summary: カメルーン極北で武装集団の襲撃が発生し、15人が死亡、数百人が家を追われ避難しています。ISIL関連組織の関与が疑われています。

articles.description: Infantino proposed an independent review of FIFA's decision-making process amid criticism of his leadership.
articles.titleJa: FIFA会長インファンティーノの書簡は再選に向けた策略、ドイツサッカー連盟が表明
articles.summary: FIFA会長インファンティーノがリーダーシップ批判の中で意思決定プロセスの独立審査を提案。ドイツサッカー連盟はこれを再選に向けた策略だと主張しています。

articles.titleJa: 米国による麻薬船への攻撃は人道に対する罪となる可能性、国連が指摘
articles.summary: 国連は、米国による麻薬密輸船への攻撃が人道に対する罪にあたる可能性があると報告した。

articles.title: Haiti extradites 18 suspects in assassination of president to US
articles.description: The suspects were flown to Miami to stand trial over the murder of Haitian President Jovenel Moise five years ago.
articles.titleJa: ハイチ、大統領暗殺容疑者18人を米国に引き渡し
articles.summary: ハイチは、5年前に殺害された大統領暗殺事件の容疑者18人を裁判のため米国へ引き渡した。

articles.title: GB dominate Ecuador to reach Davis Cup Finals
articles.description: Great Britain will play in the Davis Cup Finals for the first time since 2023 after claiming a 4-0 win against Ecuador in London.
articles.titleJa: 英国、エクアドルを圧倒しデビスカップ決勝進出
articles.summary: 英国はロンドンでエクアドルに4-0で勝利し、2023年以来となるデビスカップ決勝進出を果たした。

articles.title: Millions without power as Cuba hit by latest major blackout
articles.description: Widespread power outages have become increasingly common due to fuel shortages made worse by a US blockade.
articles.titleJa: キューバで大規模停電、数百万人が停電の被害に
articles.summary: 燃料不足と米国の禁輸措置で悪化した大規模停電がキューバを襲い、数百万人が影響を受けている。

articles.title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
articles.description: A spotted wildcat long mistaken for relatives has been identified as a new species in Bolivia.
articles.titleJa: 新種の野生ネコ科動物が発見、既知の生存個体は1匹のみ
articles.summary: ボリビアで、これまで近縁種と誤認されていた野生ネコ科動物が新種と特定された。既知の生存個体は1匹のみ。

articles.title: Aztec document goes on display in Mexico after 186 years abroad
articles.description: France's national library is lending the manuscript recounting the history of the Aztecs to Mexico.
articles.titleJa: 186年ぶりにメキシコでアステカ文書が公開
articles.summary: 186年間海外にあったアステカの歴史を記したフランス国立図書館所蔵の写本が、メキシコで公開された。

articles.title: 'He was a lifeline' - Families at a loss after Haitian caregivers let go in US
articles.description: Haitian immigrants make up a large portion of the already overburdened home-care workforce.
articles.titleJa: 「彼は命綱だった」－ハイチ人介護者が米国で解雇され、家族は途方に暮れる
articles.summary: 米国で、重労働を担うハイチ系移民介護者の解雇が相次ぎ、支援を失った家族が困窮している。

articles.title: Trump's response is key as Argentina's Falklands demands get louder
articles.description: With Argentina's President Milei promising "winds of change" over the Falklands, will Donald Trump shift his stance on British rule?
articles.titleJa: アルゼンチンのフォークランド諸島要求が高まる中、トランプ氏の反応が鍵
articles.summary: アルゼンチンのミレイ大統領がフォークランド諸島に関する「変化の風」を約束する中、トランプ氏の対応が注目される。

articles.title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
articles.description: The WMO has warned that the natural weather phenomenon could bring disruption to global economies.
articles.titleJa: 国連、「超大型」エルニーニョ現象を警告 各国が影響に備え
articles.summary: 世界気象機関は、「超大型」エルニーニョ現象が世界経済に混乱をもたらす可能性があると警告し、各国が備えを進めている。

articles.title: Who is Alejandro Betancourt, colourful oil baron behind US-Venezuela oil deal?
articles.description: The 46-year-old figure of international intrigue has an apparent knack for being in the right place at the right time.
articles.titleJa: 米国・ベネズエラ石油取引の背後にいる多才な石油王アレハンドロ・ベタンクールとは？
articles.summary: 国際的な謎の人物である46歳のアレハンドロ・ベタンクール氏が、米国とベネズエラ間の石油取引の背後にいる。

articles.title: The commodification of Indigenous cultures and traditions
articles.description: Too often, resources and meaning flow outward from the community that created them and enrich outsiders — often the same groups that have been oppressing them for centuries.
articles.titleJa: 先住民文化と伝統の商品化
articles.summary: 先住民の文化と伝統が商品化され、創造したコミュニティから資源や意味が外部に流出し、長年抑圧してきた者たちを富ませる問題について。

articles.title: Ecuador detains former minister José Serrano after U.S. deportation
articles.description: Deported from the United States, Ecuador’s former “superminister” now faces grave criminal investigations and political accusations in a justice system facing questions over due process.
articles.titleJa: エクアドル、米国からの強制送還後、ホセ・セラーノ元大臣を拘束
articles.summary: 米国から強制送還されたエクアドルの元「スーパー大臣」ホセ・セラーノが、重大な刑事捜査と政治的告発に直面。司法制度の適正手続きが問われている。

articles.title: The A’uwẽ-Xavante people's denunciation of megaprojects in Brazil
articles.description: An Indigenous-led campaign denounces the impacts of a mega railway project and demands respect for territory, self-determination, and the right to live and dream.
articles.titleJa: ブラジルにおけるアウウェ・シャバンテ族によるメガプロジェクト非難
articles.summary: ブラジルの先住民アウウェ・シャバンテ族が、メガ鉄道プロジェクトの影響を非難し、領土、自己決定、生活の権利への尊重を求める運動を展開している。

articles.title: ‘Pay-by-the-day’ living in Pereira: The forgotten survivors of Colombia’s earthquake
articles.description: In Pereira, Colombia, earthquake survivors living in pay-by-the-day rooms now face homelessness, overcrowded shelters, illness, and a struggle to be counted.
articles.titleJa: ペレイラでの「日払い」生活：コロンビア地震の忘れられた生存者たち
articles.summary: コロンビアのペレイラで、地震の生存者たちが日払い部屋で生活し、ホームレス、過密シェルター、病気に直面。彼らの存在は忘れられがちで、支援から漏れている。

articles.title: Venezuela’s earthquakes leave children facing trauma, displacement and food insecurity
articles.description: As families seek refuge, Venezuela’s youngest children grapple with fear, disrupted routines and the loss of basic nutritional security.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震、子供たちにトラウマ、避難、食料不安を残す
articles.summary: ベネズエラの地震により、避難を余儀なくされた家族の中で、幼い子供たちが恐怖、日常の崩壊、基本的な栄養保障の喪失に苦しんでいる。

articles.title: Amid political and economic pressure, Brazil sees a rise in land conflicts and the murders of Indigenous people
articles.description: Growing cases of violence against Indigenous people are linked to an impasse on the framework of rights and pressure against land demarcation, says the organization that advocates for Indigenous rights
articles.titleJa: 政治的・経済的圧力の中、ブラジルで土地紛争と先住民殺害が増加
articles.summary: 政治的・経済的圧力により、ブラジルで先住民に対する暴力が増加。土地の権利枠組みと土地境界画定への圧力が背景にあり、殺害事件も多発している。

articles.title: ‘The Sigh of the Earth’: Fragments from communities overlooked after Venezuela’s earthquakes
articles.description: Combining documentary photography, personal testimony, and digital intervention, the project preserves the quieter aftermath of Venezuela’s underreported communities after the earthquakes.
articles.titleJa: 「地球のため息」：ベネズエラ地震後、見過ごされたコミュニティからの断片
articles.summary: ドキュメンタリー写真、個人の証言、デジタル介入を組み合わせ、ベネズエラ地震後、ほとんど報じられないコミュニティで静かに続く影響を記録するプロジェクト。

articles.title: More than a month after Venezuela’s earthquakes: ‘I’m not leaving here until my son is found’
articles.description: One month after the two earthquakes, thousands of relatives remain beside the collapsed buildings in La Guaira despite harsh conditions and insufficient support for search efforts.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ地震から1ヶ月以上：「息子が見つかるまでここを離れない」
articles.summary: ベネズエラ地震から1ヶ月以上が経過。ラ・グアイラでは、劣悪な環境と不十分な捜索支援にもかかわらず、何千もの親族が倒壊した建物のそばに留まり続けている。

articles.title: In Brazil, court ruling sheds light on the story of an undocumented and stateless woman
articles.description: After 40 years without documents or an official identity, a woman born in Bolivia was able to regularize her immigration status and begin the process of recognition as a stateless person.
articles.titleJa: ブラジルで裁判所の判決、無国籍・無登録女性の物語を明らかに
articles.summary: ブラジルで、40年間書類も公的身分もなかったボリビア生まれの女性が、移民ステータスを正規化し、無国籍者としての認定プロセスを開始できた。

articles.title: Venezuela is burning, and I’m forced to watch from afar
articles.description: From Mexico City, an exiled Venezuelan watches her homeland collapse in real time, confronting the helplessness of displacement, authoritarian neglect, and the unbearable distance between survival and home.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラは燃えている、私は遠くから見守るしかない
articles.summary: メキシコシティから、あるベネズエラの亡命者が故国の崩壊をリアルタイムで見守り、避難生活の無力感、権威主義的な放置、そして故郷との耐え難い距離に直面している。

articles.title: Watch: Six-year-old girl from China sets new Rubik's Cube world record
articles.description: Lian Yunzhi broke the women's world record twice in three days at World Cube Association competitions.
articles.titleJa: ウォッチ：中国の6歳少女がルービックキューブ世界新記録を樹立
articles.summary: 中国の6歳の少女、リャン・ユンジーが世界ルービックキューブ連盟の大会で女性の世界記録を3日間で2度更新しました。

articles.title: Sydney policeman says he acted in self-defence in double murder trial
articles.description: Beau Lamarre-Condon says his ex-partner and his new boyfriend were accidentally shot in separate struggles.
articles.titleJa: シドニーの警察官、二重殺人裁判で正当防衛を主張
articles.summary: ボー・ラマール＝コンドン巡査は、元パートナーとその新しい恋人が別々の争いの中で誤って撃たれたと、正当防衛を主張しています。

articles.title: Former England footballer run over by pitch roller in Thailand
articles.description: Former England winger Andros Townsend jokes that playing Stoke away "wasn't so bad after all" following a bizarre incident before a game in Thailand.
articles.titleJa: 元イングランド代表サッカー選手、タイでピッチローラーに轢かれる
articles.summary: 元イングランド代表のアンドロス・タウンゼント選手がタイでの試合前、ピッチローラーに轢かれる珍事件が発生。本人は冗談を飛ばしました。

articles.title: Watch: Dramatic moment a cargo ship crashes into another vessel
articles.description: Verified footage appears to show a cargo ship colliding with a fishing boat near Singapore, with investigators still working to establish exactly when and how the crash happened.
articles.titleJa: ウォッチ：貨物船が別の船に衝突する劇的な瞬間
articles.summary: シンガポール沖で貨物船が漁船と衝突する映像が確認されました。調査員は衝突がいつ、どのように発生したかを究明中です。

articles.title: Nvidia boss rejects AI extinction fears as 'doomsday narratives'
articles.description: Jensen Huang's comments come after warnings from AI researchers that the technology could lead to human extinction.
articles.titleJa: NVIDIA最高経営責任者、AIによる人類滅亡の懸念を「終末論」と否定
articles.summary: ジェンスン・フアン氏のコメントは、AI研究者からの「テクノロジーが人類滅亡につながる可能性」という警告を受けて出されました。

articles.title: Mum's viral barefoot race sparks debate over India's education crisis
articles.description: The 47-year-old ran - and won - a 3km race where she hoped to win enough prize money to buy study books for her daughter.
articles.titleJa: 母親の裸足レースがインドの教育危機に関する議論を巻き起こす
articles.summary: 47歳の母親が娘の参考書を買うための賞金を求めて3kmの裸足レースを走り優勝。インドの教育危機に議論が巻き起こっています。

articles.title: At least 21 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
articles.description: A four-year-old child is among those killed in the attack, during which gunmen also opened fire on a police facility.
articles.titleJa: 爆発物を積んだ車両がパキスタンのモスクに突入、少なくとも21人死亡
articles.summary: パキスタンのモスクに爆発物積載車両が突入し、少なくとも21人が死亡。武装集団が警察施設も襲撃しました。

articles.title: Tata Sons: India's corporate crown braces for upheaval amid boardroom revolt
articles.description: The Tata boardroom battle has intensified over a re-appointment of its chairman and a diktat to go public.
articles.titleJa: タタ・サンズ：インドの企業界の重鎮、取締役会紛争で激動に備える
articles.summary: タタ・サンズの取締役会を巡る争いは、会長の再任と株式公開の命令を巡って激化しており、大きな混乱が予想されます。

articles.title: Three dead and eight injured in Philippines school shooting
articles.description: The gunman is among the dead in what is the third school shooting in the country since June.
articles.titleJa: フィリピンの学校銃撃で3人死亡、8人負傷
articles.summary: フィリピンの学校で銃撃事件が発生し、3人が死亡、8人が負傷しました。犯人も死亡しており、国内で6月以降3件目の学校銃撃です。

articles.title: Our head teacher was an abuser. We joined forces to get justice - now we're married
articles.description: Students spent years collecting evidence against their Indonesian principal, before falling in love.
articles.titleJa: 私たちの校長は虐待者だった。私たちは力を合わせ正義を求めた—そして今、結婚した
articles.summary: インドネシアの生徒たちは、虐待的な校長に対して何年にもわたり証拠を集めて正義を求め、その過程で恋に落ち結婚しました。

articles.title: Report spotlights role of services export promotion strategies as catalyst for development
articles.description: A new report launched by the WTO Secretariat and the UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean (UNECLAC) on 17 September draws on case studies to illustrate how developing economies' export promotion strategies can help them take advantage of growing opportunities in services trade. Export Promotion Strategies for Services: Lessons from the Developing World provides useful policy insights for developing economies, underscoring the importance of close coordination with skills upgrading and investment attraction strategies and the need to adapt export promotion mechanisms traditionally focused on goods.
articles.titleJa: 開発の触媒としてのサービス輸出促進戦略の役割に焦点を当てた報告書
articles.summary: WTOとUNECLACは共同報告書を発表。発展途上国のサービス輸出促進戦略が、貿易における新たな機会をいかに活用できるかをケーススタディで示し、政策提言を行っている。

articles.title: Young Trade Leaders meet with DG; discuss AI, environment, needs of developing economies
articles.description: Artificial intelligence (AI), the environment, and issues facing developing economies were among the topics discussed by Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala and the latest cohort of WTO Young Trade Leaders at a meeting on 17 September. The Director-General underlined that harnessing the energy and ideas of young people is essential for addressing current and future trade challenges.
articles.titleJa: 若手貿易リーダーが事務局長と会談。AI、環境、発展途上国のニーズを議論
articles.summary: WTO事務局長は若手貿易リーダーと会談し、AI、環境、発展途上国の課題について議論。貿易課題に対処するには若者のエネルギーとアイデアが不可欠だと強調した。

articles.title: WTO Public Forum 2026 spotlights role of services in driving world trade
articles.description: The 2026 edition of the WTO's Public Forum kicked off on 15 September in Geneva under the theme Powering the Future. Over three days, the Forum will welcome more than 4,600 participants from business, governments, civil society, academia and international organizations to discuss how trade in services is a key engine of development, a source of income, and a driver of job creation and empowerment worldwide.
articles.titleJa: WTO公共フォーラム2026、世界貿易を牽引するサービスの役割に焦点を当てる
articles.summary: ジュネーブで開催されたWTO公共フォーラム2026は、「未来を動かす」をテーマに、サービス貿易が開発、所得源、雇用創出、エンパワーメントの主要な原動力となることを議論した。

articles.title: World Trade Report: Trade reform to boost growth; inaction can cost 10% global GDP
articles.description: The 2026 edition of the World Trade Report – issued on 15 September - finds that a strengthened multilateral trading system could increase global GDP by roughly 3% or USD 3 trillion by 2050, while inaction to modernize the trading system could reduce global output by up to 10%. The flagship publication of the WTO Secretariat, examining what the multilateral trading system has delivered over 80 years and where it is facing challenges, offers evidence relevant to ongoing efforts to keep trade rules fit for purpose.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易報告書：貿易改革は成長を促進、怠れば世界GDPの10％を失う可能性
articles.summary: WTOの2026年世界貿易報告書は、多国間貿易システム強化で2050年までに世界GDPが3%増加するが、改革を怠れば10%減少する可能性を指摘した。

articles.title: World Trade & Tech Day: AI and trade increasingly intertwined
articles.description: Hundreds of participants gathered at the WTO for World Trade & Tech Day on 14 September, a sign of how AI is fundamentally changing the way cross-border commerce is evolving. Under the banner of "AI and Trade: Turning Potential into Progress", the day consisted of a full day of panel discussions and other knowledge-sharing opportunities aimed at fostering conversations on technology and trade. The event shone a spotlight on how AI and frontier technologies are making international trade more efficient, bringing together government leaders as well as academics and private sector representatives to discuss ways to harness AI's potential into tangible economic gains and an engine for inclusive growth.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易技術デー：AIと貿易の結びつきがますます強まる
articles.summary: WTOで開催された世界貿易技術デーでは、AIがいかに国境を越えた商取引を変革し、国際貿易を効率化するかを議論。AIの経済的利益と包摂的成長への活用が強調された。

articles.title: Russian Federation notifies launch of safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products
articles.description: On 9 September 2026, the Russian Federation notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards regarding the initiation on 7 September 2026 of a safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products with polymer coating imported into the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union.
articles.titleJa: ロシア連邦、特定の薄板鋼板製品に対するセーフガード調査の開始を通知
articles.summary: ロシア連邦はWTOセーフガード委員会に対し、ユーラシア経済連合へ輸入される特定のポリマー被覆薄板鋼板製品に対するセーフガード調査を9月7日に開始したと通知した。

articles.title: WTO study explores the role of stablecoins in international trade
articles.description: The WTO Secretariat launched a new publication on the role of stablecoins in supporting cross-border trade on 14 September on the sidelines of the WTO's first World Trade and Tech Day. The report, prepared by the Economic Research and Statistics Division and the Trade in Services and Investment Division, examines the opportunities and challenges associated with the use of stablecoins in facilitating international trade, highlighting how they can accelerate cross-border payments and their potential to increase participation in the international trading system, especially for developing economies.
articles.titleJa: WTOの調査、国際貿易におけるステーブルコインの役割を探る
articles.summary: WTO事務局は、国際貿易におけるステーブルコインの役割に関する報告書を発表。国境を越えた決済を加速し、発展途上国における国際貿易システムへの参加を促進する可能性と課題を検証する。

articles.title: Goods barometer points to resilient trade growth despite headwinds
articles.description: Global goods trade continued to strengthen in mid-2026 despite persistent geopolitical and policy-related uncertainties, according to the WTO Goods Trade Barometer released on 9 September 2026.
articles.titleJa: 物品貿易バロメーター、逆風にもかかわらず堅調な貿易成長を示す
articles.summary: 2026年9月9日に発表されたWTO物品貿易バロメーターによると、地政学的および政策関連の不確実性が続く中、2026年半ばにかけて世界の物品貿易は引き続き強化された。

articles.title: WTO issues 2026 Annual Report
articles.description: The WTO published today (9 September) its 2026 Annual Report, providing a comprehensive account of the organization’s activities in 2025 and the early part of 2026. The Report looks back at recent key events, such as the 14th Ministerial Conference in March 2026, and describes the WTO's work in addressing the challenges and opportunities facing world trade.
articles.titleJa: WTOが2026年年次報告書を発行
articles.summary: WTOは本日、2026年年次報告書を発表。2025年と2026年初頭の活動を包括的に説明し、第14回閣僚会議などの主要イベントと世界貿易の課題への取り組みを振り返る。

articles.title: New report highlights growth potential of digital trade in Latin America, Caribbean
articles.description: A new report by the WTO Secretariat, the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) and the World Bank examines how digital trade is transforming the way Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) economies connect to international markets and identifies opportunities to unlock further growth, inclusion and development for the region.
articles.titleJa: 新報告書、ラテンアメリカ・カリブ海地域におけるデジタル貿易の成長可能性を強調
articles.summary: WTO、IDB、世界銀行の報告書は、ラテンアメリカ・カリブ海地域のデジタル貿易の可能性を検証し、この地域のさらなる成長、包摂、開発を促進する機会を特定している。
